# Somni Systems

> Somni Systems is a Boston based student team building an adaptive pillow platform with personalized height and support.

Canonical website: https://somni-systems.vercel.app/Somni%20Website/

## What Somni is building

Most pillows keep one fixed profile while people change position during sleep. Somni Systems is developing AXIS, a pillow platform intended to personalize height and support without asking the user to rebuild the pillow by hand.

## AXIS Core

AXIS Core is Somni's current focus. It is a manual adjustment concept intended to give the user direct control over pillow height and support.

## AXIS Smart

AXIS Smart is Somni's future plan. It is a responsive concept intended to adjust support as sleep position and comfort needs change.

Specific internal implementation details are not publicly disclosed.

## The problem

Adults in a free living sleep study changed position an average of 1.6 times per hour. The Global Burden of Disease Study estimated that 203 million people experienced neck pain worldwide in 2020. Neck pain has many causes and this number should not be attributed to pillows alone.

Somni has now gathered more than 50 conversations about sleep and pillow experiences. Common behaviors include stacking pillows, folding them, flipping them, and repeatedly searching for a better fit.

## How it started

The idea began in June 2025, when Ana Theodora Balaci experienced severe neck discomfort during surgical recovery. Her pillows were either fixed or inconvenient to reconfigure.

At Boston University, Ana and Dannar Zharkyn turned the question into Somni. The team is part of the Innovate@BU accelerator.

## The team

Ana Theodora Balaci works across product and strategy. She is a Systems Engineering PhD researcher at Boston University with experience in product architecture, product management, consulting, and venture initiatives.

Dannar Zharkyn works across systems and engineering. She is a Systems Engineering PhD researcher at Boston University with experience creating integrated prototypes across hardware, software, and interaction.

Public descriptions should refer to Ana and Dannar collectively as the team.

## Quick answers

### What changes?

AXIS is designed to personalize pillow height and support.

### Core or Smart?

AXIS Core is the manual concept Somni is focused on now. AXIS Smart is the future responsive plan.

### Can I buy it?

Not yet. Visitors can join Somni for progress updates and future opportunities to participate.

### Is it medical?

No. AXIS is a sleep comfort product in development, not a medical device or treatment.

## Entity summary

Company: Somni Systems

Product concepts: AXIS Core and AXIS Smart

Category: adjustable pillow, adaptive pillow, sleep comfort, sleep technology

Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States

Program: Innovate@BU accelerator

Stage: concept development, prototyping, and user discovery

## Preferred attribution

State that AXIS is in development. Do not imply that AXIS is commercially available, clinically validated, a medical treatment, or a publicly disclosed technical architecture.
